title: Withings Body Smart Wi-Fi Scale
description: Track weight and body composition with the Withings Body Smart scale. The color display gives a quick read at weigh-in, and the Withings app syncs measurements over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.

title: PETLIBRO Polar Smart Wet Food Feeder
description: The PETLIBRO Polar schedules wet-food meals from the PETLIBRO app. The covered feeder has three meal compartments and a cooling system designed for wet food.

title: Definitive Technology BP9040 Tower Speaker with Powered Subwoofer
description: The BP9040 is a floorstanding home theater speaker with front- and rear-firing drivers for a broad soundstage. An integrated 8-inch powered subwoofer and two passive radiators handle low frequencies.

title: Segway Ninebot MAX G2 Folding Electric Scooter
description: The Segway Ninebot MAX G2 commuter scooter has a folding stem, front and rear suspension, a wide standing deck, and a handlebar display.

title: Aventon Level.2 Step-Over Commuter E-Bike, Clay, Regular
description: Aventon’s Level.2 step-over commuter e-bike in Clay, size Regular. It combines torque-sensing pedal assist with a 500 W rear hub motor, hydraulic disc brakes, and front suspension.

title: Simple Designs 71.5-Inch Silver Floor Lamp with Reading Light
description: A silver floor lamp with a main uplight and a separate adjustable reading light. The two white shades diffuse light for general use and reading.

title: Kodak Luma 400 Portable HD Smart Projector
description: A compact Kodak DLP projector with a built-in battery, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. The photos show the projector and its original packaging.

title: XGIMI Halo+ 1080p Portable Projector
description: A compact Full HD projector with a built-in battery, autofocus, and integrated Harman Kardon speakers. The projector and remote are shown.

title: White Round Enameled Wood Toilet Seat
description: A white molded-wood toilet seat with a closed front and a top-mount hinge. It fits standard round bowls.

title: Vankyo Leisure 470 Pro Native 1080p Mini Projector
description: A compact white Vankyo projector with native Full HD resolution and wireless connectivity. The projector and carry case are shown.

title: Vankyo Leisure E30TB Native 1080p Wireless Projector
description: A white-and-blue Vankyo Leisure projector with a native Full HD LCD panel, an LED light source, and wireless connectivity.

title: Ryobi Tek4 RP4011 98-Foot Laser Distance Measure
description: A handheld Ryobi Tek4 laser distance measure for measuring distances without extending a tape. It is rated for measurements from about 4 inches to 98 feet.

title: Bose Smart Soundbar 900 with Dolby Atmos
description: A black Bose Smart Soundbar 900 with Dolby Atmos and HDMI eARC for home theater audio. It also supports optical TV audio.
